extDescription.message: Save animated GIFs from X as real .gif files – converted locally in your browser.

warnOverLimit.message: Could not get below $1 MB – saved anyway.

toastCopiedLink.message: Your browser can't copy animated GIFs – the MP4 link was copied instead.

errNoMedia.message: No GIF found in this post.

errDecode.message: This video could not be decoded.

errDisconnected.message: Connection to the extension was lost. Please reload the page.

optionsAutoFit.message: Automatically reduce frame rate/resolution if the file is too large

optionsMaxDuration.message: Maximum clip length in seconds (0 = unlimited)

optionsPatternHint.message: Placeholders: {user}, {id}, {date}, {n} (number of the GIF in the post)

optionsPrivacy.message: Privacy: Everything is converted locally in your browser. The extension only contacts video.twimg.com (the video file) and cdn.syndication.twimg.com (looking up the video URL if needed). No data is sent to third parties.

optionsTip.message: Tip: Shift+click the GIF button to convert immediately with these defaults.
